tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༈ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ oṃ dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ye/ dza ya ba hi ni dza yo ta ta ri/ ka la ka la/ ma la ma la/ tsa la tsa la/ kṣi na kṣi na/ sarba karma/ ā ba ra ṇa ni/ me sarba dzñā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ na mo bha ga ba ti ha sa pra bha dha/ sarba buddha a ba lo ki te tsakṣu/ shro tra ghā ṇa dzi hā kā ya ma no bidya dzñā na bi sho dha ni swā hā/ phu ru phu ru/ su ru su ru/ phu rā phu rā/ pra phu rā pra phu rā/ sarba buddha a dhiṣṭhī te swā hā/ dharma dhā tu garbhe swā hā/ a bha ba swā hā/ sarba dharma a ba bo dha ni swā hā// gzungs 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong gi bar du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas stong gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa thob par 'gyur ro// bskal pa stong gi bar du 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur ro// tshe brjes nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob par 'gyur ro// 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe sangs rgyas stong mthong bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa rab tu skye bar 'gyur ro// nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum nyi shu rtsa re re brjod na ci 'dod pa rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi mdog can yang mthong bar 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yul rnams la yang mi phyed pa'i sems dad pa can du gyur te/ de la sogs pa phan yon tshad med pa dag 'byung ngo*// stong 'gyur zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
